# Overview 

This documentation describes the conception, development and evaluation of a data visualisation product. The project examines the **generational contract** (*Generationenvertrag*) in Switzerland through three thematic lenses: **Who decides?** — political participation and voting behaviour by generation; **Who pays?** — financial burdens through AHV and OKP contributions; and **Who owns?** — homeownership rates and living space by generation. The goal is to make observable patterns and differences between generations visible through interactive data visualisation, drawing on data from the SELECTS electoral survey, the Swiss Federal Statistical Office (FSO/BFS), and the federal AHV and OKP statistics portals. The resulting product is a scrollable single-page Streamlit dashboard that presents each thematic dimension as a self-contained narrative section, combining data journalism text with interactive Plotly charts.

![The vizualization product development process](pics/vizproductprocess.png){#fig-vizprocess}

The methodological procedure of this work follows the process model shown in @fig-vizprocess, which is based on the concepts on data product development outlined in @DoemerKempf2022_1000150238 and the [data science project-template](https://github.com/phonosync/dataviz-project-template) on github.

It comprises the following four main phases with the corresponding documentation artefacts:

* **Project Understanding** &rarr; [Project Charta](00_project_charta.qmd): Context analysis, stakeholder and user analysis (based on the Value Proposition Canvas), formulation of objectives, success criteria, constraints and the visualization concept.
* **Data Acquisition and Exploration** &rarr; [Data Report](01_data_report.qmd): Identification and acquisition of relevant data sources, followed by exploratory data analysis to understand data quality and structure.
* **Visual Encoding and Design** &rarr; [Visualization Design Report](03_viz_design_report.qmd): Documentation of the data-to-visual mapping, layout and composition, interaction design, visual style and the resulting prototype(s).
* **Evaluation** &rarr; [Evaluation Report](05_evaluation.qmd): Assessment of the developed prototype based on success criteria outlined in the project charta, evaluation of stakeholder feedback, checkpoint decision and, if applicable, gathering additional requirements and planning of the deployment.
* **Deployment** &rarr; [Deployment Report](04_deployment.qmd): Description of the software architecture and deployment process, as well as the integration of the visualization product into the target environment and processes.

Parts of the code and documentation in this project were developed with the assistance of an AI language model [@anthropic_claude_2026]. All outputs were reviewed, adapted, and verified by the project team.
